report.scoping: This report covers all covered markets for August 2026. It is drawn from 57 projects and 137 captured records. Of those projects, 15 are described in full, selected by significance; 36 further projects are counted but not described; 6 projects filed nothing in this period. A further 3 projects in this geography are excluded because our capture holds no published name for them; the coverage note says where. 215 projects this scope proposes are held out of this document because they have not been confirmed as part of JKR & Associates' coverage. A scope is a proposal: it finds projects that look like a match, and each one is confirmed by hand on the register before it may be printed. Those projects are on the register, unconfirmed, and are not a statement that they do not belong here. Anything outside that geography or period is not covered here.
